verdict.rationale: Relay documents payment approvals as its own feature: a support article titled 'How to Set Up Payment Approvals', multi-step approval rules on the pricing page, bill-pay approval automation with task delegation, and role-based team access. Together these cover designating teammates who can approve payments. The evidence is mostly headlines and marketing lines, though, and a community note about 'issues with permissions' is too vague to count as a contradiction. Missing for 10: evidence of the one-click approve-and-send flow, detailed docs on how approver permissions are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
